authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10539 rakta explicitly covers both red and blood, including Bshk rat, K. rath and L. rattā. The source red/blood forms fit that semantic family; prefixed arattā needs separate ārakta comparison. Reviewed comparison: bundeli_atarra rakat  “blood” (f_snnbzyal6zebq). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7150 nikta gives nīk/nīkā good through the MIA replacement *nikka and notes Persian nēk influence on nekā. I-vowel good forms fit this family; bare nek remains a potential Persian loan. Reviewed comparison: bundeli_atarra nīk “good” (f_m2ounedfmjf6s). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
